findings.title: Efficacy and Safety of Dual and Triple GLP-1-Based Polyagonists in MASLD and MASH: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis (Cureus)
findings.whatChanged: Pools pemvidutide with tirzepatide, survodutide, retatrutide and cotadutide (6 RCTs, 961 participants). Cureus is a low-tier journal — use only as a pointer to the underlying RCTs, per the site's source-tier rules.
